citations.claim: first violation: total energy far exceeds bound at final step
energy one step before was normal and below initial, so injection happens in step 30->31
heavy resting body gains huge spurious horizontal velocity in the collision step

counterfactual.change: Reduced body 1 initial downward speed from -58.017 to -5.0 (one field); gentler impact no longer triggers three-way energy injection, same 31 steps passes.

explanation: No controller work (controller disabled, work=0). Heavy body 0 (m~19.3, e=0) is settling on floor at y~0.83 while light body 1 falls fast onto it. At step 30 bodies are separate; at step 31 they are in contact (gap 0.017) with body 0 on floor (y=r). Resolving near-simultaneous floor + body-body contacts with impulses plus positional correction injects energy: body 0 jumps from vx=-1.94, speed~7.5 to vx=+38.4, and total energy jumps from ~1065 to ~14654 despite e=0/0.64 dissipative contacts and no external work. Spurious horizontal kick from an essentially vertical impact indicates contact solver / correction error under heavy-light mass ratio and high impact speed in a resting-contact squeeze.
vision_note: The small upper circle falls vertically toward the larger lower circle resting just above the floor over steps 28 to 30. At step 31 the two circles make contact in a near-vertical stack low in the arena with no obvious large horizontal displacement yet.
